title: NativeOntologyImportPreview
description: Dry run of a native ontology import. Nothing is persisted until the change set is created and applied.

counts.description: Every parsed definition is counted once as new, updated, or skipped. Mappings are counted inside their concepts.

newRelations.description: Axioms the target does not hold yet.

newMappings.description: Concept mappings the target does not hold yet.

skippedDefinitions.description: Parsed definitions identical to the stored ones.

detectedFormat.description: Format the server parsed: the requested format, or the detected one when the request omits it.

ontologyLabel.description: Label of the source ontology, when the file declares one.

changeSet.description: Draft operations for the target ontology. Absent when the preview ran without a target.
